info.title: Seren Private Models
info.description: List and run organization private models through seren-private-models. OpenAI-compatible clients can use https://api.serendb.com/publishers/seren-private-models/v1 as their Base URL for GET /models and POST /chat/completions; that address returns plain OpenAI JSON and errors and keeps payment headers. Claude-compatible clients use https://api.serendb.com/publishers/seren-private-models as their Base URL for GET /v1/models and POST /v1/messages. GET /models and POST /chat/completions keep their billing response envelopes.

200.description: Chat completion as JSON, or server-sent events when stream is true. Budgeted runs include task, day, and balance observations. Streaming payment details are returned in response headers. A request that names a model is answered by that model, or by a configured fallback only while the named model is temporarily unavailable. A request that names no model uses the organization's ordered models, moving to the next when one is unavailable. A per-call request never falls back to a model that costs more per input or output token, or whose price is unknown, and a request with images never falls back. When another model answers, the completion body and the first stream event carry `seren_fallback` with `requested_model`, `answered_model` and `reason` (`temporary_outage` or `model_unavailable`), and the call is charged at the answering model's price.

X-Seren-Answered-Model.description: The model that answered, present only when it differs from the requested model.

X-Seren-Ignored-Parameters.description: The request fields Seren left out, comma-separated, such as `temperature, stream_options`; present only when a field was left out.

X-Seren-Model-First-Token-Seconds.description: Time from provider request to first generated output, in seconds, when observed.

X-Seren-Requested-Model.description: The requested model, present only when another model answered.

X-Seren-Schema-Check.description: Present as `failed; <first violation>` when a constraint omitted from structured output was violated. The answer is returned without an automatic retry; callers can validate and repair it.

X-Seren-Schema-Relaxed.description: JSON Schema keywords the answering Claude model could not enforce; present only when the schema was adapted. The original constraints remain instructions.

X-Seren-Tool-Choice.description: Set to not-honored when a model that cannot force tool calls still misses a required or named tool after one retry. Usage includes both attempts.

400.description: The request is invalid. A field Seren does not take is refused with `unsupported_request_field`, and the message names the field and what to send instead.

402.description: Insufficient SerenBucks (x402), or a bare managed run refusal with code budget_reached (scope, limit_atomic, used_atomic, suggested_increase_atomic) or balance_exhausted (balance_atomic). Refusals before generation remain JSON for streaming requests too.

403.description: Private models are not configured for this organization, the deployment key lacks Private Models access (`private_models_deployment_key_missing_scope`), a hired managed agent's deployment key named no run in `X-Seren-Run-Id` (`run_required`), named a run of another deployment (`run_not_in_deployment`), or named a run with no model-call funding (`run_funding_required`)

404.description: No private model provider serves the requested model (`model_not_found`). Nothing is charged.

409.description: The run named in `X-Seren-Run-Id` has ended or is being cancelled (`run_not_active`)

502.description: The model provider failed or its outcome is unknown

503.description: An earlier model request of the run awaits usage reconciliation

200.description: A Python 3.9+ script, with no dependencies outside Python's standard library, that sends this service the requests common OpenAI- and Claude-format tools send and prints, for each, whether it passed, the HTTP status, the parameters Seren left out, Seren's message and what to do. It exits non-zero when any request fails. It reads the key from `SEREN_MODEL_KEY` or `OPENAI_API_KEY` and never prints it; `--base-url` and `--model` (default `$SEREN_MODEL`, then `opus-5-5`) choose what it checks. Downloading it needs no key.

403.description: Private models are not configured for this organization, or the deployment key lacks Private Models access (`private_models_deployment_key_missing_scope`)

200.description: The same call as `POST /chat/completions`, with the same models, fallbacks, charges, run limits and headers. A reply that is not streamed is the chat completion as plain OpenAI JSON; when stream is true, OpenAI's server-sent events.

X-Seren-Answered-Model.description: The model that answered, present only when it differs from the requested model.

X-Seren-Ignored-Parameters.description: The request fields Seren left out, comma-separated, such as `temperature, stream_options`; present only when a field was left out.

X-Seren-Model-First-Token-Seconds.description: Time from provider request to first generated output, in seconds, when observed.

X-Seren-Requested-Model.description: The requested model, present only when another model answered.

X-Seren-Schema-Check.description: Present as `failed; <first violation>` when a constraint omitted from structured output was violated. The answer is returned without an automatic retry; callers can validate and repair it.

X-Seren-Schema-Relaxed.description: JSON Schema keywords the answering Claude model could not enforce; present only when the schema was adapted. The original constraints remain instructions.

X-Seren-Tool-Choice.description: Set to not-honored when a model that cannot force tool calls still misses a required or named tool after one retry. Usage includes both attempts.

400.description: The request is invalid. A field Seren does not take is refused with `unsupported_request_field`. Errors use OpenAI's shape, `{"error": {"message", "code", "type"}}`, with Seren's code in `code`.

402.description: OpenAI error JSON, including for streaming requests refused before generation. `error.code` is `budget_reached` with `scope`, `limit_atomic`, `used_atomic`, and `suggested_increase_atomic`, or `balance_exhausted` with `balance_atomic`. `error.message` explains the amounts and how to continue. Other payment refusals retain their code and details. The shared-model OpenAI address, `/publishers/seren-models/v1/chat/completions`, uses the same refusal format.

403.description: Private models are not configured for this organization, or the key cannot call them on this run (`private_models_deployment_key_missing_scope`, `run_required`, `run_not_in_deployment` or `run_funding_required`)

404.description: No private model provider serves the requested model (`model_not_found`). Nothing is charged.

409.description: The run named in `X-Seren-Run-Id` has ended or is being cancelled (`run_not_active`)

502.description: The model provider failed or its outcome is unknown

503.description: An earlier model request of the run awaits usage reconciliation

requestBody.description: An Anthropic Messages request. `model` names a Claude model, by Anthropic's name (for example `claude-opus-5-5`) or Seren's (`opus-5-5`). Every other Messages field is passed to the model unchanged, except that `temperature`, `top_p` and `top_k` are left out for a model that does not take them, `temperature` and `top_p` are left out when `thinking` is not disabled, and a Claude Fable 5 `temperature` other than 1.0 is left out; the reply's `X-Seren-Ignored-Parameters` header names each field left out. The values of each `anthropic-beta` header are added to `anthropic_beta`. Sign in with `Authorization: Bearer <key>` or `x-api-key: <key>`.

200.description: Claude's reply in the Messages format, or, when `stream` is true, the Messages server-sent events as the model produces them, with a `ping` event at least every 15 seconds while none arrive. A non-streamed reply carries payment details in response headers. The call is charged from the reply's usage, including cached input; a request is never answered by another model.

X-Seren-Ignored-Parameters.description: The request fields Seren left out, comma-separated, such as `temperature`; present only when a field was left out.

400.description: The request is invalid; the model's reason for refusing it is returned (`invalid_request_error`)

402.description: Insufficient SerenBucks, or a managed run's spending stop; the message starts with Seren's code, such as `budget_reached` (`billing_error`)

403.description: The caller lacks Private Models access; the message starts with Seren's code (`permission_error`)

404.description: The model is not a Claude model this caller can use; the message lists the Claude models available. Nothing is charged (`not_found_error`)

409.description: The run named in `X-Seren-Run-Id` has ended or is being cancelled (`run_not_active`)

429.description: The model is temporarily unavailable; retry after the `retry-after` seconds (`rate_limit_error`)

502.description: The model provider failed or its outcome is unknown (`api_error`)

200.description: The models `GET /models` lists, as a plain list in OpenAI's shape that also carries the fields of Anthropic's model list, so a client whose OpenAI-format Base URL ends in `/v1`, or whose Claude-format Base URL is the publisher's address, can read it.

401.description: Authentication required. Sign in with `Authorization: Bearer <key>` or `x-api-key: <key>`. Errors use OpenAI's shape, `{"error": {"message", "code", "type"}}`.

403.description: Private models are not configured for this organization, or the deployment key lacks Private Models access (`private_models_deployment_key_missing_scope`)

409.description: The run named by a run model key has ended (`run_not_active`)

total_cost.description: Total cost in asset units (as decimal string)

Eip712TypedData.description: EIP-712 typed data for signing payment authorization

ManagedAgentBudgetShortfall.description: The other limit that cannot cover the amount a stop's suggested raise is sized for.

oneOf.description: The other limit, when it is also too short for suggested_increase_atomic to let the task finish.

held_atomic.description: Included in used_atomic; absent on stops recorded by older runtimes.

step_increase_atomic.description: Additional allowance for one step; zero when the existing allowance covers it.

ManagedAgentBudgetStop.description: A turn-ending refusal. It is not a provider failure and must never trigger fallback.

count.description: Number of items in this response

has_more.description: Whether there are more items after this page

total.description: Total number of items across all pages

PaymentRequestInfo.description: Internal payment request tracking (extends with Seren-specific fields)

oneOf.description: EIP-712 typed data for signing (EIP-3009 only)

PaymentRequiredResponse.description:
x402 V2 402 Payment Required Response

The official V2 format with top-level resource info and extensions support.

error.description: Error message explaining why payment is required

extensions.description: Optional extensions (V2 feature for protocol extensibility)

resource.description: Resource information (V2 - moved to top level)

PaymentRequiredResponseWithInfo.description: 402 Payment Required response body (x402 v2) with Seren-specific extensions.

PaymentRequirements.description:
x402 V2 Payment Requirements

Follows the official x402 V2 specification.
See: https://github.com/coinbase/x402/blob/main/typescript/packages/core/src/types/payments.ts

extra.description:
Extra information about the payment (scheme-specific)

For EVM/exact scheme, this typically contains:
- `name`: Asset name (e.g., "USD Coin")
- `version`: Asset version
- `eip712TypedData`: EIP-712 typed data for signing (EIP-3009)
- `paymentRequestId`: Correlation ID
- `expires`: Expiration timestamp
- `estimate`: Cost breakdown (optional)
- `settlementMethod`: "eip3009" or "transfer"

maxTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time in seconds for the resource server to respond

network.description: Network for payment in CAIP-2 format (e.g., "eip155:8453" for Base mainnet)

payTo.description: Address to pay value to (publisher or gateway wallet)

PrivateModelsChatCompletionsRequest.description: The chat completion request body as callers send it. Fields that change nothing Seren does (`user`, `metadata`, `store`, `service_tier`, `prompt_cache_key`, `safety_identifier`, `parallel_tool_calls`, `stream_options`, `n` of 1, `logprobs` false and `modalities` of text only) are accepted and left out. `n` above 1, `logprobs` true, `top_logprobs`, `audio`, other `modalities`, `prediction`, `functions`, `function_call` and any field not listed here are refused with `unsupported_request_field`. A null field is the same as an absent one.

frequency_penalty.description: Sent to models that take it; left out, and named in `X-Seren-Ignored-Parameters`, for the others.

logit_bias.description: Sent to models that take it; left out, and named in `X-Seren-Ignored-Parameters`, for the others.

max_completion_tokens.description: OpenAI's name for `max_tokens`. When both fields are sent they must be equal.

presence_penalty.description: Sent to models that take it; left out, and named in `X-Seren-Ignored-Parameters`, for the others.

oneOf.description: How much the model thinks before it answers. Omit it for no thinking.

OpenAI's name for `reasoning.effort`, and another way to set it. `none` means no thinking, the same as omitting both fields; every other value means the same as in `reasoning.effort`. When both fields are sent they must name the same effort.

response_format.description: OpenAI's way to set `response_schema`: `{"type":"json_schema","json_schema":{"schema":...}}` sets that schema, `{"type":"json_object"}` asks for a JSON object, and `{"type":"text"}` asks for plain text. Send it or `response_schema`, not both.

response_schema.description: A JSON schema the reply must follow.

seed.description: Sent to models that take it; left out, and named in `X-Seren-Ignored-Parameters`, for the others.

stop.description: One sequence, or a list of them, at which the model stops.

temperature.description: Left out, and named in `X-Seren-Ignored-Parameters`, for a model that does not take it, when reasoning is set, and for a Claude Fable 5 value other than 1.0.

tool_choice.description:
`auto` (the default), `none` (the model is sent no tools), `required` (the model must call a tool), or `{"type":"function","function":{"name":...}}` (the model must call that tool, which must be in `tools`).
Models that cannot force a tool call use an instruction and one retry; a second miss sets X-Seren-Tool-Choice: not-honored. Both attempts count toward usage. Converted turns omit signed reasoning while preserving text and tool history; ordinary signed replay with tools is unchanged.

top_k.description: Left out, and named in `X-Seren-Ignored-Parameters`, for a model that does not take it.

top_p.description: Left out, and named in `X-Seren-Ignored-Parameters`, for a model that does not take it and when reasoning is set.

image_input.description: Whether the catalog confirms that this model accepts image input.

PrivateModelsNativeListResponse.description:
The model list in OpenAI's and Anthropic's list shapes, without Seren's
response envelope.

first_id.description: The first model's ID, or null when the list is empty.

has_more.description: Always false: every model is in one page.

last_id.description: The last model's ID, or null when the list is empty.

created_at.description: When the list was made, in RFC 3339.

PrivateModelsNativeModelInfo.description:
A model in the plain list, with the fields both OpenAI's and Anthropic's
model lists carry.

PrivateModelsPaymentRequired.description: A publisher payment request or a managed run's graceful spending stop.

ResourceInfo.description:
Resource information for x402 V2

In V2, resource metadata is a top-level field rather than being
embedded in each payment requirement.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the resource response

url.description: URL of the resource being paid for
